verdict.rationale: The docs say a Bot can save a multi-step path as a skill and rerun it on a schedule, with a dedicated routines page giving a concrete "every weekday at 8:00 AM" routine. Routines can also start from events such as Slack or GitHub notifications, and they run on a persistent cloud computer while the laptop is closed. A month-long community user confirms that each bot owns its own routines. Missing for 10: documentation of how schedules are configured, monitored and handled on failure (e.g. schedule syntax, run history, retries), and any programmatic API or CLI for managing scheduled jobs (the probe found no Grok Bot developer surface).
